adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the calendar id like:

- `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the branch that’s supposed to be the fallback), the `.find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `null/undefined`, so the find will not select any normal destination calendar entry and will return `undefined`. This makes the fallback effectively dead and risks updating/deleting against an undefined/wrong calendar id (or falling back to `primary` if the call site later defaults), which can leave stale/orphaned events.

This is grounded in the diff: the predicate explicitly uses `externalCalendarId` inside the fallback branch, so it cannot locate a real destination calendar when `externalCalendarId` is missing. The finding’s suggested fix (select by credentialId) is consistent with the new multi-destination design introduced in this PR (e.g., `createEvent` now receives `credentialId` and selects the destination calendar via `cal.credentialId === credentialId`).
